chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salmah ibn al-Khattab, from Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, adorned our Shias with forbearance and covered them with knowledge, due to His knowledge of them before He created Adam (peace be upon him).'
ai.seo_question: What qualities did Allah bestow upon the Shias before the creation of Adam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) declares that Allah adorned the Shias with forbearance (hilm) and enveloped them in knowledge, a distinction rooted in divine foreknowledge prior to the creation of Adam. This hadith underscores the concept of *al-Dhahab* (the golden thread) of spiritual excellence, linking the Shias' intellectual and moral virtues directly to God's eternal decree and their unique status as the bearers of divine wisdom.
